status: post-hoc research choice for on-device display: notebook 04 v5's predeclared rule selected cnn_1d; cnn_v5_h had higher ICU sensitivity at a higher healthy false-alert rate
architecture: PulseCNN5: Conv(1>8,k9,s2)+pool2, Conv(8>16,k7)+pool2, Conv(16>16,k7)+pool2, Conv(16>24,k5,d2)+pool2, Conv(24>24,k5,d2)+adaptive-max(8), Linear(192>1); ReLU; mean of 3 member sigmoids
training: PhysioNet/CinC 2015 ICU alarms (514 records, 123 true) plus 50 pulse-visible healthy WildPPG sternum windows from each of an0, e61, fex, k2s, kjd, l38, n31, ngh

input.ir_sign: clinical PLETH convention (raw optical intensity negated)

parity_tolerance: absolute 2e-5 on probabilities (float32 accumulation order differs)
